registry.selection: closed issues, sorted by comments, skip items with pull_request key
registry.notes: Blocked on 3 crawler gaps: (1) no auth header support, unauthenticated limit is 60 req/h; needs GITHUB_TOKEN from env (5000 req/h). (2) pagination is in the Link header, but ApiMapping.next_path only reads the JSON body. (3) one source = one base_url, so either one source per repo or a fan-out step that enqueues one API target per repo from the allowlist. The issues endpoint also returns PRs; drop items with a pull_request key. Comments need a second call per issue (/issues/N/comments).

Small live sample only; the bulk path is the offline dump (offline_datasets.json). Quota: 300 req/day without a key, 10K with one. Pagination uses page=N + has_more, which next_path can't express yet. Answers need /questions/{ids}/answers. creation_date is a unix timestamp: check parse_record_date handles ints.
